objectives: 本課程旨在深入探討 SAP ERP S/4 HANA GUI/FIORI系統 。學生將學習核心組織結構配置，並透過 後勤模組與程式語言的交互堆疊協助，更全面掌握各模組（SAP FI／CO／WM／EAM／PS／CS）核心功能，包含採購、銷售、應付帳款與成本中心會計、庫存管理、專案管理及客戶服務。同時，本課程結合 SAP Learning Hub 線上電子學習資源、後勤資源及程式語言，輔導學生考取 SAP TS 410 財務模組及SAP 業界原廠專業認證。
content:
Part 1
SAP S/4HANA Enterprise Management: Overview
New User Experience: SAP Fiori UX
System-wide concepts
Record to Report Processing: Financial Accounting and Management Accounting
Hire to Retire Processing in SAP S/4HANA
Source to Pay Processing in SAP S/4HANA
Warehouse ＆ Inventory Management
Design to Operate Processing in SAP S/4HANA
Lead to Cash Processing in SAP S/4HANA
Project System
SAP Enterprise Asset Management

Part 2
Introduction to SAP Programming Development  Tools and
Use Open SQL and native SQL to extract all your Part 1 practice.

Part 3
the SAP TS 410 Financials certification and obtain official SAP certifications.
